triples.subject: Alexey Fyodorovitch
triples.quote: Alyosha came to see his sick brother twice a day.

triples.subject: Ivan Fyodorovitch
triples.quote: not Dmitri Fyodorovitch, but the man lying the other side of that door, who has sacrificed himself for his brother

triples.subject: Katerina Ivanovna
triples.quote: when I myself had told him long before that I did not love Dmitri, that I loved no one but him!

triples.subject: Katerina Ivanovna
triples.quote: he instantly imagined I was jealous of Dmitri and that I still loved Dmitri.

triples.subject: Katerina Ivanovna
triples.quote: He had told me the main idea three days before, and we began quarreling about it at once and quarreled for three days.

triples.subject: Ivan Fyodorovitch
triples.quote: Katerina Ivanovna had immediately after the scene at the trial ordered the sick and unconscious man to be carried to her house

triples.subject: Katerina Ivanovna
triples.quote: She was suffering for her “treachery” at the trial, and Alyosha felt that her conscience was impelling her to confess it to him

triples.subject: Ivan Fyodorovitch
triples.quote: Three days later, on the evening you came, he brought me a sealed envelope, which I was to open at once, if anything happened to him.
